brief:
Berlin police detained at least two people during a pro-Palestinian demonstration in the German capital on Saturday, Reuters reported. A large number of pro-Palestinian protesters had gathered for the event, drawing an official response from law enforcement authorities in the city.

The specific circumstances that led to the detentions and the exact reasons police intervened at the demonstration remain unclear from available accounts. No additional details about the protesters' identities, charges, or the scale of the gathering have been reported.

title: Police detain two protesters at Berlin pro-Palestine rally
